Package edu.cnu.mdi.splot.fit

Enum Class CurveDrawingMethod

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CurveDrawingMethod>
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.fit.CurveDrawingMethod
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CurveDrawingMethod>, Constable
public enum CurveDrawingMethod extends Enum<CurveDrawingMethod>
Specifies how a curve should be drawn for a data set.

Historically this was named FitType, but that name was misleading because several options are not fits at all (e.g. connect, stairs, none).

Some drawing methods optionally consume a FitResult (Apache Commons Math based), or a CubicSpline.
